items.title: Failed sends leave the RPC live:
items.body: Failed sends leave the RPC live:
items.suggestion: Record terminal failures, wake receivers, return the failure through `Recv`, and release the handle. Test this through `GRPCStreamProvider`, including writer closure after a rejected write.

items.title: Queued read payloads bypass byte accounting
items.body: Queued read payloads bypass byte accounting. Read RPCs supply a size function returning zero, then clone payloads into queued responses at line 65. With `MaxBytes=10`, endpoint `"one"`, stream `"s"/"1"`, and a five-byte record, stored data already consumes all ten bytes; reading still succeeds and retains another five bytes internally. Multiple pending readers multiply this excess. Write response request IDs likewise use a separate per-handle budget without contributing to `dialer.bytes`.
items.suggestion: Account for retained response data in a shared byte budget, reserving capacity before cloning or changing fencing/write state. Release reservations on receive, cancellation, and close. Add combined storage-and-queue capacity tests.
